description: Master index of system invariants across all gddp-runtime architectural surfaces.

invariants.name: Human Authority on Graph Truth
invariants.quoted_invariant: Only a human operator modifying graph truth (gddp node browse) can transition a node to accepted.
invariants.rule: Preserve all node acceptance and graph truth modifications exclusively for human operators.
invariants.drift_pattern: Automated scripts or evaluators modifying node YAML status to accepted.

invariants.name: Intent Preservation and Node Integrity
invariants.quoted_invariant: A node is the atomic unit of project intent. It defines the goal, constraints, and acceptance criteria.
invariants.rule: Restrict implementation and evaluation strictly to the declared scope of the target node.
invariants.drift_pattern: Expanding node scope during implementation or retries without human-approved graph amendments.

invariants.name: Evaluator and Verification Integrity
invariants.quoted_invariant: No admission gate, verification mechanism, policy layer, intermediate check, or other governance mechanism may suppress or preempt evaluation.
invariants.rule: Allow the evaluation harness to formulate independent verdict receipts on all execution returns.
invariants.drift_pattern: Preempting evaluation when intermediate gates or unit tests encounter failures.

invariants.name: Storage and Evidence Doctrine
invariants.quoted_invariant: Files are Truth: Durable files (GDDP_RECEIPTS_PATH, verdict YAMLs, git worktrees) constitute primary truth. The SQLite database (db/queue.db) is a rebuildable cache and index; nothing of architectural value is lost if queue.db is purged.
invariants.rule: Treat durable files and git refs as primary evidence, treating databases as disposable caches.
invariants.drift_pattern: Relying on database rows as truth while omitting durable filesystem receipts.

invariants.name: Execution Isolation and Infrastructure Boundaries
invariants.quoted_invariant: Every agent execution session operates in a dedicated, isolated git worktree (.worktrees/ or session temporary directory). Open-heart surgery on repository checkouts is forbidden.
invariants.rule: Confine all automated code mutations to isolated worktrees.
invariants.drift_pattern: Executing mutative tasks directly in the primary workspace checkout.

invariants.name: Development and Agent Workflow Invariants
invariants.quoted_invariant: All changes must originate on a dedicated branch (feat/, fix/, docs/, refactor/, chore/). Every logical change is committed immediately with conventional commit syntax and co-authorship metadata.
invariants.rule: Author changes on dedicated branches with conventional commits and agent co-authorship trailers.
invariants.drift_pattern: Committing unstructured changes directly to main without agent co-authorship metadata.
